text:
Maria: Heads up — deploybot started rollout for release v3.9.1; feature flag `smart-routing-v2` ramping to 25%. Hold manual unpin until we validate telemetry.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by @Maria. ID: db-78321. Rolling cohorts: 5% -> 25% over 10m. Canary checks enabled.

Sam: seeing p95 jump on inference-prod in us-west around 22:02 UTC, anyone else? :eyes:

Kevin: confirmed. p95 +160ms, error rate still ~0.6%. Might be KV cache thrash with new kernel selection.

Lina: remind the threshold: customer-impact rule is either errors >= 5% OR sustained p95 >200ms for 5m. If hit, we should auto rollback unless SRE permits manual hold.

Sam: proposing conservative rollback conditions for this rollout: 
- errors > 3% sustained for 3m OR
- p95 increase > 150ms sustained for 5m OR
- request queue length > 500 for 2m
If any trigger, roll back to pinned model version.

Maria: +1. Also add an immediate "pause" action on first p95 drift so humans can triage. Deploy-bot can hold at the 10m mark and notify oncall.

Kevin: can we also auto-pin to previous stable model on rollback? i.e. rollback -> pin v3.8.4 to avoid flapping.

deploy-bot: Holdpoint configured: cohort 25% hold at +10m. Alerts will go to #eng-oncall and p95+errors alerts channel.

Sam: operational commands (for quick action):
`/ff set smart-routing-v2 cohort=0%`
`/deploybot rollback db-78321 --to-version v3.8.4 --reason "p95 regression"`
`/deploybot pause db-78321 --at-minutes 10`

Maria: please update release notes/runbook if we use rollback: include cause, telemetry links, and next steps (cache investigation + canary load test).

Lina: I drafted a short customer comms note and put it in the drive: https://docs.google.com/... (commented for review).

OpsOnCall: oncall here — acked. I'll escalate and trigger rollback if the combined thresholds above are hit. Will post timestamped decisions in this thread. :thumbsup:

Kevin: running synthetic load with pinned model now to compare. Sharing quick run snippet:
```
wrk -t4 -c200 -d120s http://inference-us-west.internal/healthcheck
observed: p95=120ms (pinned) vs p95=280ms (ramp)
```

Sam: noted. If that gap persists after 5m, we should rollback. I'll add the thresholds to the alert rule temporarily.

deploy-bot: db-78321 -> rollout to 25% resumed. Canary passed 3m health checks. Monitoring enabled.

Maria: thanks. If no regressions in the next 15m we'll continue to 50%. If we hit any trigger, follow Sam's rollback commands and paste the command here when executed.

Kevin: dashboard pinned to the FF route and model version. Synthetic load running for 12m now. Will update.

Sam: prepping postmortem template in case we need it. Will include timeline, metrics, root-cause actions.

Maria: closing for now — ping here for any alerts or if someone needs help executing the rollback.

OpsOnCall: will report back if thresholds breached or action taken.
